proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x ha hD
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hD
  generalize Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - a * c) = s at hs ⊢
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : (a * x + b - s) * (a * x + b + s) = 0 := by linear_combination a * h - hs
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h1 with h2 | h2
    · left
      rw [eq_div_iff ha]
      linarith
    · right
      rw [eq_div_iff ha]
      linarith
  · rintro (h | h)
    · have hx : a * x = -b + s := by
        rw [h]
        field_simp
      have h1 : a * (a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) = 0 := by
        linear_combination (a * x + b + s) * hx + hs
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h1).resolve_left ha
    · have hx : a * x = -b - s := by
        rw [h]
        field_simp
      have h1 : a * (a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) = 0 := by
        linear_combination (a * x + b - s) * hx + hs
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h1).resolve_left ha
target_source: ∀ (a b c x : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ b ^ 2 - a * c → (a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c = 0 ↔ x = (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - a * c)) / a ∨ x = (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - a * c)) / a)
